title: Free credit sizing & trial UX experiments + enterprise security questionnaire alignment
creator: Ava Chen
description: Run a set of coordinated product experiments to optimize free-tier credits, trial expirations, and upgrade prompts to improve PLG conversion while simultaneously completing the enterprise contract/security questionnaire needs so Sales can close deals without last-minute product exceptions. Scope includes: experiment design and implementation for credit sizes (500k / 1M / 2M tokens), expiration policies (30 / 60 / 90 days + inactivity extension), in-app upgrade nudges and billing page flows; instrumentation for conversion and unit economics; and a parallel checklist to answer top-20 security questionnaire items (SSO, KMS, audit logs, data retention, incident response) and map product gaps to short-term mitigations or enterprise contract language.
acceptance_criteria: [1] Experiment infra deployed: user cohorts segmented, flags and telemetry working; [2] Conversion lift and cost per converted account computed for each variant; [3] Upgrade flow A/B released to 10% of new signups; [4] Security questionnaire draft completed with engineering/legal owners assigned for each open item; [5] Sales enablement playbook updated with approved responses and mitigation language.
metrics: Activation rate (first 7 days), conversion to paid within 30/60/90 days, CPAC (cost per acquired customer), time-to-first-successful-inference, helpdesk tickets from trial users, questionnaire item completion percent

notes_and_tradeoffs: Tradeoffs discussed: larger credit sizes increase short-term conversion but can materially raise cost for heavy eval users; we will cap per-account concurrency and instrument early throttles. For enterprise questionnaire items we will prefer product mitigations (audit logging, KMS integration) over contract-level concessions where feasible. Consider a commercial credit top-up flow for proof-of-concept piloting to avoid long free periods for prospective enterprise customers.
sales_enablement: Updated playbook draft in Confluence with canned answers for security QA items and escalation path to Eng/Legal. Include approved upgrade messaging and price anchor examples for AE demos.
